_doc: APPROVED CONTENT OVERRIDE for RDD-2026-36. The LIVE Lark Campaign Calendar remains the planning source and is untouched (read-only). This file expresses what the calendar's single `product_categories` field cannot: the calendar specifies TWO categories ("Sit Stand Desks, Ergonomic Chairs"), so the grouped product selection is given here by verified BigCommerce product id. Product data is still fetched live and verified at generation time (never fabricated). Subject and promotion are taken verbatim from the Lark record. Copy follows CLAUDE.md: NO DASH (§6.2/§6.25), non-empty preview (§6.24), no invented claims, no invented expiry date.

_source.calendar: Lark Base (live API), RDD Campaign Calendar, record RDD-2026-36
_source.no_expiry_date: The Lark record carries NO offer expiry date. Per the Holiday Playbook a deadline must never be invented or softened, so no end date is stated anywhere in the copy. Confirm and add a real expiry before send.

The component supports a text-led hero; approved band artwork is a pre-send item (§6.13-H).
